cleanPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached DELTA NOVA fleet roster atlas. Create a cleaned second candidate of these SAME EIGHT spacecraft, preserving their role silhouettes, recognizable white titanium/dark graphite palette, cyan cockpit glazing, warm amber engine accents and three-quarter camera pointing down-left. This is production sprite artwork for 120px strategy-game cards. Improve real structural clarity and eliminate noisy AI-looking greebles. Keep premium hard-surface realism, not cartoon toys or flat vector art.

Layout is mandatory: exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows on a fully transparent 2:1 canvas (prefer 2048x1024, each cell512 square). Each entire ship must stay within the CENTRAL 76% of its own cell with at least12% fully transparent padding on ALL FOUR sides. Never cross cell boundaries. Uniform optical scale and centered anchors, no cropping, no other ships, no text, no logos, no numbers, no backgrounds, no grid lines, no ground shadows.

Cell order must remain exact:
top-left STRIKER: agile pointed frigate, cockpit between two clear propulsion nacelles, two swept fins.
top-second GUARDIAN: wider heavy armored escort with distinct broad shoulders and a short solid nose.
top-third SIEGE: long narrow heavy hull with two large straight clearly terminated forward cannon barrels.
top-right SUPPORT: compact repair tender, rounded workshop cabin and TWO simple clean folded manipulator arms; each arm only two segments plus one clear jaw, no tiny fingers/cables/extra joints.
bottom-left SALVAGE: boxy freighter, THREE coherent large cargo modules on spine and one simple broad recovery clamp; no curling spaghetti arms or scattered debris.
bottom-second SCOUT: retain the elegant small dagger cockpit and two swept spars/engine tips, clean wide negative spaces.
bottom-third JAMMER: sturdy compact hull, one large clean circular radar dish on one solid mount and two broad signal panels, NO forest of needles, no impossible floating antennas.
bottom-right CARRIER: broad unmistakable launch deck and one large open hangar bay, structural hull connecting both sides, four balanced engine pods. Keep this whole silhouette well inside its cell.

Replace dozens of microscopic scratches, rivets, random dark flecks and ambiguous protrusions with a small deliberate set of broad hull plates and clean panel seams. All guns, limbs, engines and panels must visibly connect to a hull. Matte/satin metal with controlled highlights, crisp clean antialiased transparent edges with NO white fringe or colored speckle. Light from upper-left. The eight ships should look like a designed family, remain distinguishable at72px and120px, and preserve the original game's serious military orbital material language. Only this candidate will be reviewed; do not bake any UI into it.
